title: ambush:hold:v1
description:
The rendered hold card, in the case channel. This is the row an operator reads; the needs-action QUEUE row is the separate kind:46010 notice (event-46010-hold-notice.schema.json), per 10-RELAY-FORK.md decision RF-D3.

One hold produces two or more cards: an OPEN card (state=created|notified|armed|deciding) and exactly one TERMINAL card (state=granted|refused|expired|executed|failed) published as a NIP-10 reply to the open card. The terminal card is the appendix's 'also the expiry record'. Both carry the full hold, because a card is immutable and the timeline must read top to bottom without a join.

remaining_ms and expired are NOT on this card. They are clock-derived, the card is immutable, and INV-06 requires the two to be two separate rendered facts. The console computes both from expires_at_ms.

Tier 0. The HeldActionStore record carries no signature; the ActionRequest inside it may carry a governance_receipt in `evidence`, which is a separate, separately-badged object.

issuer.description: WHO PRODUCED THE FACT — the agent whose SwarmAction became this ActionRequest. `role` may be null: request_from_action sets `requested_by: agent_id.clone()` (crates/swarm-runtime/src/dispatcher.rs:1338-1345) from whatever AgentId the emitting agent holds, and on the Whisker/ingest path that is a derived `swarm:ed25519:<hex>`-shaped identity, which infer_agent_role (crates/swarm-runtime/src/detection/pipeline.rs:583-604) prefix-matches to None. See common.schema.json#/$defs/FactIssuer.

emitted_at_ms.description: The RuntimeEvent's own emitted_at_ms, carried through unchanged. THE SORT KEY for every Perch surface. The Nostr event's `created_at` is a transport timestamp stamped at publish, because MAX_TIMESTAMP_DRIFT_SECS is 900 and REJECTS (crates/buzz-relay/src/handlers/ingest.rs:2224-2231) and `created_at` is inside the Nostr signature, so a spooled card carrying its true emit time becomes permanently unpublishable fifteen minutes after it was produced.

finding_card_id.description: The Nostr event id of the ambush:finding:v1 card this hold answers, when one exists.

hold.description: HeldActionView minus the two clock-derived fields. Field-for-field the same object as build/openapi/perch-operator-v1.yaml#/components/schemas/HeldActionView, which is normative for the HTTP shape; this schema is normative for the wire shape and the two are held together by tools/check-perch-wire-parity.sh (PROPOSED).

action_request.description: crates/swarm-policy/src/lib.rs:45-58. `severity` and the threat class inside `evidence` are set by the REQUESTING AGENT and read back by ConfigurableApprovalGate::selector_matches (crates/swarm-policy/src/configurable_gate.rs:44-56), so an agent influences which rule judges its own destructive action. The WHY WE ARE ASKING slot must mark both request-carried.

requested_by.description: An Ambush AgentId. NOT a Nostr pubkey and there is no mapping to one anywhere in swarm-core/src/config, which is why no Perch card p-tags the requesting agent.

action_request.x-carried-note: This object is a domain type carried VERBATIM. The Rust wire crate names the type rather than redeclaring its fields, so a field added upstream reaches the wire with no edit and a field removed upstream is a compile error. tools/check-perch-wire-parity.sh skips its property names on the Rust side for exactly that reason, and the golden vectors plus this schema are what hold the shape.

The Rust wire crate names the type rather than redeclaring its fields, so a field added upstream reaches the wire with no edit and a field removed upstream is a compile error. tools/check-perch-wire-parity.sh skips its property names on the Rust side for exactly that reason, and the golden vectors plus this schema are what hold the shape.

rationale.description: NEW IN B1, mirroring build/openapi/perch-operator-v1.yaml#/components/schemas/HoldRationale. It exists because policy_decision is a single constant pair for all twelve action kinds.

leases_a_containment.description: is_containment_action(action) (crates/swarm-runtime/src/containment.rs:54-63). False for eight of the twelve destructive kinds, and a false here means the card renders NO pending containment-lease slot rather than an empty one.

inverse_resolution.description: Empty when rehearsal is null. DERIVED, marked as such.

decision.description: Null on the open card, set on the terminal card.

policy_decision.reason: authorized but held for human approval

rationale.reason: authorized but held for human approval

HoldDecisionRecord.description: Mirrors build/openapi/perch-operator-v1.yaml#/components/schemas/HoldDecisionRecord. `decision` is grant|refuse and never `deny`: appendix section 7 rules `refuse` to the operator, `deny` to the policy and `veto` to governance.
